name: Ancient Egypt
hook: Gods, pharaohs and the Nile: the ancient civilization Jeopardy visits from Alexandria to Tut.

facts.label: the 365-day calendar
facts.statement: Ancient Egypt produced the first known calendar with 365 days.

facts.label: the Ennead
facts.statement: The Ennead was the pantheon of Atum, Tefnut and seven others; Ra was the sun god, Khepri at dawn and Atum at evening.

facts.label: Osiris and Isis
facts.statement: Seth sealed his brother Osiris in a coffin, making him lord and judge of the underworld; Isis, his wife, is often shown suckling Horus.

facts.label: Memphis
facts.statement: Memphis was Egypt's capital for centuries; its ruins supplied the stones used to build Cairo.

facts.label: Alexandria
facts.statement: Alexandria was nicknamed "Mother of Books" for its ancient library, and Hypatia taught mathematics there.

facts.label: papyrus
facts.statement: Papyrus, the writing material made from a Nile reed, gives its name to the Rhind papyrus, an Egyptian math text.

facts.label: King Tut
facts.statement: King Tut restored Thebes as the capital and was "discovered" in 1922, setting off a worldwide craze.
